english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for entering marriage.
Use this for the informal English sense of getting hitched; Cantonese does not need a special informal verb here.
Use this when joining specifically means marrying.

examples.english: We plan to marry next year.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 nin4 daa2 syun3 git3 fan1

examples.english: They dated for years and finally decided to hitch up.
examples.traditional: 佢哋拍拖多年，終於決定結婚喇。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 do1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 git3 fan1 laa3

examples.english: They’ll join their lives in marriage next year.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haa6 nin4 git3 fan1
